# Synthetic fixtures

All fixtures added here must be invented and contain no real personal data or
copied corpus text. Keep each below 10 KB and label the scenario synthetic.
No corpus fixtures are needed in T1. T2 begins with invented Act-like sections
whose identifiers cannot be mistaken for genuine legal citations.

# T6 model-task fixture

`model-tasks.json` contains 18 invented requests/labels, including six blocked
urgent cases. Sinhala, Tamil and Singlish labels are UNREVIEWED seeds, not a
language benchmark. Fake replay copies labels and measures only the harness.
No real statute, user situation, model response or legal conclusion is included.
